(1) The only receipted offset object in the program is possession_features.OFFSET_COLUMN = 'log_projected_team_off_possessions', constructed as np.log(projected_team_off_possessions) at possession_features.py line 319 and handed to the gates renamed 'log_exposure' at line 515; the module docstring (lines 62-64) states 'projected_team_off_possessions: it is the OFFSET (as a log), not a feature'. A linear predictor carrying the receipted log-scale offset reproduces the incumbent's frozen prediction at zero treatment if and only if the mean is exp(linear predictor), i.e. the link is log. (3) GATE_INVOCATION_CONTRACT.md section 3.1 records the program-wide convention: 'every turnover arm carries log(exposure) (and log(D)) in the offset'. Per RESEARCH_CONTRACT_V1 precedence the implementation governs over prose; the implementation is unambiguous.

inference_spec_gap_resolution.estimation_objective_frozen_here: The link is receipted; the response family is fixed by NO receipt and none is claimed. This preregistration FREEZES the estimation objective as Poisson quasi-likelihood IRLS (log link, receipted log_exposure offset) for every arm and every K0_MATCHED null identically: quasi-likelihood uses only the mean-variance relation for point estimation, the target's measured under-dispersion (0.193, V2_STOP_CONDITION retired-families note) biases only likelihood-based standard errors, and NO likelihood-based standard error is ever used - all inference below is game-cluster bootstrap. Deterministic IRLS; no stochastic fitting component; identical convergence tolerance (1e-10 on deviance change, max 100 iterations) on arm and null.

inference.estimand: out-of-fold prediction error on REGULATION_EQUIVALENT_TEAM_OFFENSIVE_POSSESSIONS, per team-game row, pooled over the arm's evaluable folds
inference.primary_gate: delta_MAE = MAE(K0_MATCHED[arm]) - MAE(arm), pooled out-of-fold over the arm's evaluable folds. Promotion requires ALL of: (a) delta_MAE > 0; (b) two-sided cluster-bootstrap p-value for delta_MAE below the arm's family-Holm-adjusted alpha (family-wise alpha = 0.05); (c) no kill condition triggered; (d) P28 ordering: this primary verdict is frozen and content-addressed before any downstream turnover number is computed; downstream turnover results never rescue a failing possession candidate.
inference.row_weights: equal per team-game row (EVIDENCE_PACKET_V2.inference_specification.row_weighting; no task card overrides it)
inference.resampling: game-clustered bootstrap, stratified by fold: within each evaluable fold's TEST rows, resample the fold's test game-clusters with replacement, carrying BOTH team-rows of every sampled game; never resample team-rows independently. B = 10,000 draws. Draw b uses the SAME resampled cluster index set for the arm, its K0_MATCHED null, and every other arm evaluated in that fold, so all comparisons are paired.
inference.coefficient_inference: per-fold treatment coefficients are fitted on TRAINING rows only. Coefficient intervals: game-cluster bootstrap over the fold's TRAINING clusters with refit, B = 2,000, percentile 95%, per evaluable fold. 'theta = 0 not rejected across folds' is operationalised as: the 95% interval covers 0 in EVERY evaluable fold. 'Sign instability' is operationalised as: any two evaluable folds whose point estimates have opposite signs. Kill conditions are evaluated UNCORRECTED (a kill can only remove an arm, never promote one; uncorrected kills are the conservative direction).
inference.k0_flat: K0_FLAT (intercept-only) is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; it appears in no promotion decision. K0_MATCHED is authoritative and PER-ARM.
inference.permutation_nulls: NO arm in this preregistration uses a permutation null; every null is term_removal or parameter_fixed_at_null (S9 discipline: the nested null is the only valid control for level-transport-adjacent arms, stated per arm).
inference.guards_at_call_site: before any fit, every arm's complete per-fold design [offset | nuisance | candidate] passes postgame_surrogate_guard (P22, sha256 951e85132f470fdd939c8039958f0544413aaaa485da5dba7da9c1b9b73ceeda), merge_guard (P23), offset_dependency_guard (P25/R11) invoked with offset = log_exposure AND incumbent_projection = projected_team_off_possessions (the R11 t09 result shows the incumbent_projection argument is load-bearing when the offset is a log), and fold_estimability_guard (P27/R12), per GATE_INVOCATION_CONTRACT sections 1-6.
